create_RcfrSolver: create an RcfrSolver instance to solve a game with infinite regret data buffer and regression models
create_ReservoirRcfrSolver: create a ReservoirRcfrSolver instance with bounded reservoir buffer for memory-efficient regret storage
build_DeepRcfrModel: build a DeepRcfrModel neural network with configurable hidden layers and skip connections for regret regression
analyze_RootStateWrapper: analyze a game root state with RootStateWrapper to enumerate sequence features and map information states to sequence indices
construct_sequence_features: construct sequence feature tensors by concatenating state features with one-hot action encodings for regression
